name: dsh-agent-token-stats
description: Cross-agent local LLM token usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI: scans Claude Code / OpenCode / Cursor IDE / DSH / OpenClaw / QClaw / CodeWhale / WorkBuddy / WPS Claude / Hermes logs (plus Codex/Gemini/Cline/Pi parsers on standby), keeps a persistent ratchet ledger in ~/.agent-token-stats, and serves a sidebar analytics panel with cache-hit rate, cost estimation, period comparison, day drill-down and CSV export.
